Discard technical noise: values that cannot occur in reality.\n    noise_mask = (\n        (df[\"bmi\"] < BMI_MIN)\n        | (df[\"bmi\"] > BMI_MAX)\n        | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] < GLUCOSE_MIN)\n        | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] > GLUCOSE_MAX)\n        | (df[\"age\"] > AGE_MAX)\n    )\n    noise_idx = set(df.index[noise_mask])\n\n    clean = df[~noise_mask].copy()\n\n    # 2. Standard 3*IQR outlier detection on the numerical columns.\n    age_out = set(clean.index[_iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"age\"])])\n    bmi_out = set(clean.index[_iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"bmi\"])])\n\n    glucose_candidates = clean.index[_iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])]\n    stroke_rate = clean.loc[glucose_candidates, \"stroke\"].mean() if len(glucose_candidates) else 0.0\n\n    if stroke_rate >= 0.5:\n        # Strongly associated with stroke -> not technical outliers.\n        glucose_out = set()\n    elif stroke_rate > 0.2:\n        # Moderately associated -> re-check after a log2 transform.\n        log_glucose = np.log2(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n        log_candidates = clean.index[_iqr_outlier_mask(log_glucose)]\n        if len(log_candidates) == 0:\n            glucose_out = set()\n        else:\n            log_stroke_rate = clean.loc[log_candidates, \"stroke\"].mean()\n            glucose_out = set() if log_stroke_rate >= 0.5 else set(log_candidates)\n    else:\n        glucose_out = set(glucose_candidates)\n\n    standard_outliers = age_out | bmi_out | glucose_out\n\n    # 3. Remove standard outliers, then build the risk proxy on what remains.\n    clean = clean.drop(index=standard_outliers)\n    for col in NUM_COLS:\n        clean[f\"{col}_norm\"] = clean[col] / clean[col].max()\n    clean[\"risk_proxy\"] = (\n        clean[\"age_norm\"] * clean[\"bmi_norm\"] * clean[\"avg_glucose_level_norm\"]\n    )\n\n    # 4. Multivariate outliers via Mahalanobis distance / chi-square critical value.\n    X = clean[NUM_COLS].to_numpy()\n    mean = X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    diff = X - mean\n    mahalanobis_sq = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    critical_value = chi2.ppf(1 - CHI2_ALPHA, df=len(NUM_COLS))\n    mahalanobis_out = set(clean.index[mahalanobis_sq > critical_value])\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations.\n    child_smokers = set(\n        df.index[\n            (df[\"work_type\"] == \"children\")\n            & (df[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"]))\n        ]\n    )\n    toddler_students = set(\n        df.index[(df[\"age\"] <= TODDLER_MAX_AGE) & (df[\"work_type\"] == \"student\")]\n    )\n    # sanity-check: \"children\" work_type rows older than the child age threshold\n    overage_children = set(\n        df.index[(df[\"work_type\"] == \"children\") & (df[\"age\"] > CHILD_MAX_AGE)]\n    )\n\n    all_outliers = (\n        noise_idx\n        | standard_outliers\n        | mahalanobis_out\n        | child_smokers\n        | toddler_students\n        | overage_children\n    )\n\n    return sorted(int(i) for i in all_outliers)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1530,"cache_read_input_tokens":50016,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1530,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f2d0b79d-ee52-44b6-a167-cefc496b2460","uuid":"579d9f88-0bac-4666-a2e4-d52fc84fc069","request_id":"req_011CcrynN1ioFwE97HPrVGgp"}

Remove standard outliers, then build the risk proxy on what remains.\n    clean = clean.drop(index=standard_outliers)\n    for col in NUM_COLS:\n        clean[f\"{col}_norm\"] = clean[col] / clean[col].max()\n    clean[\"risk_proxy\"] = (\n        clean[\"age_norm\"] * clean[\"bmi_norm\"] * clean[\"avg_glucose_level_norm\"]\n    )\n\n    # 4. Multivariate outliers via Mahalanobis distance / chi-square critical value.\n    X = clean[NUM_COLS].to_numpy()\n    mean = X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    diff = X - mean\n    mahalanobis_sq = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    critical_value = chi2.ppf(1 - CHI2_ALPHA, df=len(NUM_COLS))\n    mahalanobis_out = set(clean.index[mahalanobis_sq > critical_value])\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations.\n    child_smokers = set(\n        df.index[\n            (df[\"work_type\"] == \"children\")\n            & (df[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"]))\n        ]\n    )\n    toddler_students = set(\n        df.index[(df[\"age\"] <= TODDLER_MAX_AGE) & (df[\"work_type\"] == \"student\")]\n    )\n    # sanity-check: \"children\" work_type rows older than the child age threshold\n    overage_children = set(\n        df.index[(df[\"work_type\"] == \"children\") & (df[\"age\"] > CHILD_MAX_AGE)]\n    )\n\n    all_outliers = (\n        noise_idx\n        | standard_outliers\n        | mahalanobis_out\n        | child_smokers\n        | toddler_students\n        | overage_children\n    )\n\n    return sorted(int(i) for i in all_outliers)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
